text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange sees week of weakness with a drop in the index and trading volume and value.
- Official says Kuwait's trade with pro-Iraq states was not suspended after the 1991 Gulf War.
- Kuwait wins several prizes at Arab television and radio festival in Cairo.
- Government to discuss at weekly Sunday meeting medical insurance for residents in the welfare state.
- Syria surprised at Qatar's insistence to host an Arab- Israeli economic summit in November.
- Kuwait Crown Prince and Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah received in London the head of the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) Jameel al-Hujailan.
- Two sentenced to death for drug smuggling. Kuwait made drug trafficking a capital crime in 1995.
- Iran says GCC states ready to sign security pact with it but Britain and the United States are blocking the move.
